# Shyfted Next

> Shyfted Next is a premier digital agency based in Dhaka, serving clients globally. We specialize in crafting high-retention video editing and high-converting websites for top brands, creators, and executives.

## Core Services
- **Video Editing**: High-retention short-form and long-form video editing (Reels, TikToks, YouTube, documentaries).
- **Web Development & Redesign**: Modern, lightning-fast, high-converting websites and web applications.
- **Signature Identity**: Executive digital footprint optimization and Google Knowledge Panel positioning.
